SERVICES AGREEMENT
This Services Agreement is entered into on 2026-02-01 between Brightline Analytics Ltd
("Provider") and Harbor Logistics Inc ("Client").
WHEREAS the Client wishes to engage the Provider for data services;
the parties hereby agree as follows.
1. Term. This agreement is effective from 2026-02-01 and expires on 2027-01-31.
2. Fees. The Client shall pay a fixed fee of 48000.00 USD, within 30 days of invoice.
3. Termination. Either party may terminate with 60 days written notice.
4. Governing law. This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York.
Signed: Maria Keller, Brightline Analytics Ltd
Signed: Tom Reyes, Harbor Logistics Inc
